identitySignals: Name matches exactly: 'Alameda Health System', an integrated public health care system organized as a public hospital authority in Alameda County, CA (Wikipedia)
Operates Highland Hospital in Oakland and other Alameda County health facilities, consistent with a health-related MOU with OUSD's Community Schools and Student Services Department
research.notes: The organization's own website (alamedahealthsystem.org) failed automated fetching (certificate error) and the web search budget was exhausted, so website, contact details and registry IDs were not confirmed and are left null. No page was found linking AHS to OUSD directly; the OUSD community schools page did not name it. ProPublica lists only related entities (Alameda Health System Foundation, EIN 94-3103136; Alameda Health System Medical Staff), which are separate from the public hospital authority itself, so no EIN is given. Needs manual verification of the official site before publishing.

profile.summary: Alameda Health System is a public hospital authority in Alameda County, California. It runs hospitals, including Highland Hospital in Oakland, and primary care clinics that serve the county, including low-income residents. It is governed by a board of trustees appointed by the Alameda County Board of Supervisors.
